note: D8 cross-language crypto vector — mac = hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, 'fn-boot' 0x00 bootId 0x00 decimal(ts)))
ackNote: WIN-10 mutual auth — ackMac = hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, 'fn-ack' 0x00 nonce 0x00 bootId)). A DIFFERENT context string from the client's MAC, so neither direction's transcript replays as the other's.
